note: the deflate 32 KiB window guard is dropped so matches reach past it, caught by InflateTests.deflateWindowLimit
the deflate hash chain is one step at every level, caught by InflateTests.deflateLevelsSearchLonger
deflate levels past 9 search a longer chain instead of acting as level 9, caught by DeflateTests.niceLengthEndsTheSearch
deflate's code length limiter is skipped so clamped codes overfill Kraft's sum, caught by DeflateTests.lengthsStayWithinTheLimit
deflate's fixed or dynamic block choice is inverted, caught by DeflateTests.skewedBytesTakeDynamicBlocks
deflate never stores a block that does not compress, caught by DeflateTests.randomBytesTakeStoredBlocks
deflate's nice length is ignored so the search never stops early, caught by DeflateTests.niceLengthEndsTheSearch
anchor: if best >= nice || best == most { break }
